title: SQL MAX() Function
text:
SQL
MAX()
Function



The SQL MAX() Function

The
MAX()
function returns the largest value of the selected column.

The
MAX()
function works with numeric, string, and date data types.

MAX() Syntax

SELECT MAX(
column_name
)
FROM
table_name
WHERE
condition
;
